The '''Keeper's World system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained [[Keeper's World]].

==Description==
The Keeper's World system was an uncharted [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained one planet of note, the [[Keeper's World]], a planet with a temperate climate suitable for life. The environment of the Keeper's World was artificially created by [[The Keeper]].<ref name="TKS" />

==History==
Long before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the Keeper's World system was caught up in another [[Unidentified war|war]] which devastated the system and rendered its primary planet uninhabitable. In the face of this war the [[Keeper's makers|spacefaring race]] which dwelled on the Keeper's World fled the system, leaving behind The Keeper to restore their planet in preparation for their eventual return.<ref name="TKS" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was patrolling the uncharted system when a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] malfunction sent a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Leia Organa's Rebel scout craft|scout craft]] into their midst, sparking the [[Battle of The Keeper's World]].<ref name="UPSWS1">{{StoryCite|story=Untitled Pizzazz 1 comic|book=Pizzazz 1|sformatted=Untitled comic}}</ref> During the course of that battle the [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Keeper's World)|Imperial commander]] in charge of the fleet became erroneously convinced that the Keeper's World was dangerously unstable. He informed the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to stay away from the Keeper's World system in the future.
